Tapes and wefts are made flat and narrow and sit close to the head. Andrea tells you honestly what is possible for you.

about.metaDescription: Andrea has worked with hair since she was 19, starting in Rio de Janeiro. Today she runs her atelier in Iserlohn: extensions, toppers, wigs and hair systems in human hair, also made to measure.
about.title: It's not just hair. *It's so much more.*
about.lead: The story of Andreia Pereira Da Costa, whom everyone calls Andrea: from Rio de Janeiro to an atelier in Iserlohn.

chapters.label: Rio de Janeiro
chapters.title: It begins *at 19.*
chapters.text: In Rio de Janeiro, Andrea starts working with hair and stays with it for many years. In Brazil, hair matters a great deal. People care about it because it is more than beauty.
chapters.quote: “Hair shows who you are inside, from the inside out.”

chapters.label: A new start
chapters.title: A new country. *A new language.*
chapters.text: Andrea moves to Germany. Because she hardly speaks German at first, she works in care for many years, with people with disabilities. There she learns to meet people with patience and dignity. It still shapes how she advises today.

chapters.label: Her own experience
chapters.title: She knows *how it feels.*
chapters.text: Andrea knows hair loss from her own experience. She wears a hairpiece she made herself. Whoever comes to her talks to someone who knows that look in the mirror.
chapters.quote: “I know exactly what hair means to a person, because I have lived it myself.”

chapters.label: It has to be real
chapters.title: Real. *And made for everyday life.*
chapters.text: She once tried a hairpiece made from other hair. It let her down in everyday life, in the sauna for example. Since then she has been certain: it has to be real hair, and it has to hold up in life, not just in the mirror.

chapters.label: The atelier
chapters.title: Back *to hair.*
chapters.text: About three years ago, Andrea founded her own atelier in Iserlohn and returned to her craft: extensions, toppers, wigs and hair systems in human hair, also made to measure.
chapters.quote: “I am happiest in my atelier, when I am making my pieces.”

chapters.label: The phoenix
chapters.title: As if *reborn.*
chapters.text: Her sign is the phoenix. It stands for before and after. Anyone who has lost hair, through alopecia or simply over the years, and recognises themselves in the mirror again with the right hairpiece, often feels as if reborn.
chapters.quote: “When the hair is back, you are a different person. You are as if reborn.”

chapters.label: What drives her
chapters.title: For *everyone.*
chapters.text: Andrea wants to help people who feel the way she once felt. For every hair colour, every texture, every background: blonde, brunette, red, black, straight, wavy, curly, coily. Nobody should think: this isn't for me.
chapters.quote: “It matters to me that I help people. Then my conscience is at peace.”

pdp.helpersTitle: Will it suit me? Quick check
pdp.heightTitle: How will the hair fall on me?
pdp.heightNote: A guide based on body proportions. Hair follows the shape of the head, so it looks slightly shorter. Andrea is happy to advise you more precisely.
pdp.baseTitle: Will the base fit my head?
pdp.baseLead: Hold a bank card (85.6 × 54 mm) against the screen and drag the slider until the rectangle is the same size. Then you see the base at true size.
pdp.baseSlider: Match the rectangle to your bank card
pdp.baseTooBig: Too large for true size on this screen. Rotate your device or use a larger display.
pdp.baseFinger: For comparison: four fingers side by side are usually about 7 to 8 cm wide.
pdp.clipNote: Simulation: a recreated click sound, not a recording of this piece.
pdp.loupe: Turn on loupe: magnify the hairline and hair structure
pdp.daily: Worked example: about {perDay} per day over 2 years of wear ({price} ÷ 730 days).
pdp.partingText: Every hair is worked in individually, so you wear the parting where you like, without a sewn-in line.
pdp.weightText: One pack weighs {grams} g. For comparison, a smartphone weighs about 200 g.
pdp.returnOpen: How trying it at home works
pdp.returnStep1: Receive the piece and look at it in daylight.
pdp.returnStep2: Try it on carefully, as in a shop. Please do not cut, dye, wash or glue it.
pdp.returnStep3: Withdraw within 14 days without giving reasons. You bear the cost of returning it.
pdp.returnCustom: Made-to-measure pieces are excluded from withdrawal.
pdp.shareText: Have a look at this piece from Andrea’s Fashion Hair: {name}

cat.lightNote: Approximation: shows how colour can change under different light.
cat.matchOpen: Match your own hair · 100 % on your device
cat.matchTitle: Match the colour of your hair
cat.matchLead: Choose a photo of your hair in daylight. It is analysed only in your browser and never uploaded.
cat.matchError: The photo could not be read. Please try another one.
cat.matchNote: A guide on screen, not a substitute for Andrea’s advice. Pieces are then sorted by colour similarity.
